name: openburnbar
description: OpenBurnBar hosted MCP for spend and capability diagnostics. Session, knowledge, and resume tools require the local preprocessing/decrypt shim that is not bundled in this HTTP-only marketplace plugin.

OPENBURNBAR_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: OpenBurnBar MCP access token
OPENBURNBAR_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Short-lived (~15 min) hosted-MCP access token. Live setup is blocked until the attested burnbar.ai/link flow is deployed and BurnBar exposes a safe copy/export action. `openburnbar mcp login` stores the token in Keychain and does not print a value to paste. Never put a refresh token here.
